changelog: - **Save selected structure works on a selection that holds a delivery line.** In the seawater desalination Template, selecting a chemical delivery together with its tank, or the whole diagram, and choosing File ▸ Save selected structure… did nothing at all: no file and no message. The line between them reads a table of what a delivery makes available, which needs a newer file version than the save picked, so the file was refused. The save now picks the version by the same rule the file's own checks use, and such a selection is saved with its table. A selection without such a line is saved as before. If a structure file is ever refused, the save now says why instead of doing nothing.
